tasks.short: Track inventory, sales, insurance, and bookkeeping

steps.what: Perform tracking of inventory by counting frames and lenses on the shelf.
inputs: frames and lenses on the shelf

steps.what: Read sales of frames and lenses stored for these administrative duties.
Draft simple bookkeeping lines quoting only sale date, amount, and frames or lenses.
Check bookkeeping lines while performing the match to those sales.
Post the checked simple bookkeeping lines as book v1.
Write the patient insurance information from the prescription and the sale.
Finish submitting that patient insurance information to the insurer as claim v1.

tasks.design: She still counts frames and lenses on the shelf and still opens and reads the sales in the {OTHER} optical shop system. A configured copy fills ledger lines in the {ERP} from sale date, amount, and whether the item was frames or lenses; she checks the amount and the frames or lenses on every line, then posts book v1 herself. She still writes and submits the patient insurance information as claim v1. No stock listing is produced, no alert is raised, nothing is sent to the client, and the system does not send the insurance claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: The ledger would not take a sale line unless someone retyped the date, the amount, and whether it was frames or lenses.
tasks.enabler_now: The sale record already stores those three fields, so a configured copy can fill the ledger line without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A sale missing the amount still needs her to type that line.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether a line is a real sale before she posts book v1.
tasks.altitude: She still counts, still reads sales, still checks every line, still posts book v1, and still submits insurance; the week loses only the retyping of lines the sale already stored.

reach.learn: The insurance submission is claim v1 she sends, separate from the ledger line.

evidence.claim: Copying sale date, amount, and item type into a ledger line is bookkeeping, not a clinical reading. Imaging, pharmacy, laboratory, coding, and general-practice scribe figures in this digest are other occupations and are not used as hours for this task. This is model knowledge.
Health data are a special category.
Software that has a medical purpose is a medical device.

assumptions: The sale record is produced at the till, outside the bookkeeping step. Each sale already stores sale date, amount in currency, and item type frames or lenses. That capture is not counted as time saved.
If sale date, amount, or item type is missing, the draft leaves that line blank and she types it while checking the line.

She still counts inventory on the shelf, still opens and reads the sales, still checks every bookkeeping line against the sale amount and whether it was frames or lenses, still posts book v1, and still submits the insurance claim herself.
No stock listing is produced, no alert is raised, nothing is sent to the client, and the system does not send the insurance claim.
The one upkeep hour is for retiring a sale-field mapping when the shop stops using a frames or lenses code.
unknowns: Whether the shop sale stores sale date, amount, and item type as separate fields or only as a free-text note.
Whether this employer requires a second person to approve book v1.
Whether logging her ledger corrections counts as staff monitoring.
research_questions: How often a sale is missing the amount so she types the line in the check.

already_counted.description: Comparing bookkeeping lines to the sales she already read, which stays inside the check.

incremental.description: Retiring a sale-field mapping when the shop stops using a frames or lenses code.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one shop day, the low is a day when sale date, amount, or item type is missing, so she types the line during the check and the draft share is not saved. The high is the 16-point retyping of those three fields minus the one upkeep hour. She still counts inventory, still reads sales, still checks every line, still posts book v1, and still submits insurance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Decide which points these clients need for their eyeglasses.
Instruct clients in the room on wear and care of eyeglasses.

tasks.design: She decides which points these clients need and instructs them in the room on how to wear and care for eyeglasses. No version of the instruction is filed. No listing replaces that instruction, no alert is raised, and nothing is sent afterwards.
tasks.previous_blocker: The instruction depends on watching how this client holds the eyeglasses.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the need to instruct the client in the room.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong hold of the eyeglasses is seen only while she is with the client.
tasks.human_edge: She corrects the client's hold of the eyeglasses in the room.
tasks.altitude: She still instructs every client in the room; the week does not change.

reach.learn: The instruction is spoken in the room with that client.

evidence.claim: Instructing clients how to wear and care for eyeglasses is spoken in the room with that client. This is model knowledge, not a measured case.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She speaks to the client in the room. No version of the instruction is filed, so the instructing is not gated.
She still instructs the client. No listing replaces that instruction. No alert is raised and nothing is sent afterwards.
unknowns: Whether this shop also hands the client a written care note, which this task does not file.
research_questions: Whether any client leaves without the spoken instruction.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One client visit: she still decides the points and still instructs the client in the room, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Watch student opticians during their training on a fitting.
Supervise the training by telling those student opticians what to change.

tasks.design: She watches student opticians during a fitting and tells them what to change. The student optician is staff in training. No version is filed, so the supervising is not gated. No listing is produced, no alert is raised, no training record is published, and nothing is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: What the student should change is seen only during the fitting.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new replaces watching the student and telling them what to change.
tasks.still_hard: A poor fitting is corrected only while she is there.
tasks.human_edge: She judges the fitting and tells the student optician what to change.
tasks.altitude: She still watches every fitting and still tells the student what to change; the week does not change.

reach.task: supervise a student during a fitting
reach.learn: The correction is spoken to the student, not filed.

evidence.claim: Supervising the training of student opticians is watching a fitting and telling the student what to change. This is model knowledge, not a measured case.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She speaks to the student optician, who is staff in training, not to a client. No version is filed, so the supervising is not gated.
No listing is produced, no alert is raised, no training record is published, and nothing is sent.
unknowns: Whether this employer also requires a signed training record after the fitting, which this task does not file.
research_questions: How often a student fitting needs a second correction after she has left the room.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One training fitting: she still watches and still tells the student optician what to change, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order and purchase frames and lenses

steps.what: Read which frames and lenses the shop is short of.
outputs: frames and lenses that are short

steps.what: Decide the order and purchase quantities for those frames and lenses.
inputs: frames and lenses that are short

steps.what: Write the purchase order for those frames and lenses.
Send that purchase order for the frames and lenses to the supplier as order v1.

tasks.design: She still reads which frames and lenses the shop is short of, decides the order and purchase quantities, and writes the purchase order. She sends that order to the supplier herself as order v1. No listing replaces the reading, no alert is raised, and the system does not send the order.
tasks.previous_blocker: The quantities depend on what she sees is short and what she chooses to buy.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new chooses the quantities or sends the order for her.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong quantity reaches the supplier only if she sends it.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the quantities and sends order v1 herself.
tasks.altitude: She still reads the shortage, still decides the quantities, and still sends every purchase order; the week does not change.

reach.learn: The supplier receives only order v1 after she sends it.

evidence.claim: Ordering and purchasing frames and lenses is her decision of quantities and her send of the purchase order to the supplier. This is model knowledge, not a measured case.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The supplier is outside the organisation. She sends order v1 herself and that send is the gated step. No second copy is filed.
She still opens and reads which frames and lenses are short. No listing replaces that reading, no alert is raised, and the system does not send the order.
unknowns: Whether a manager must also approve the purchase.
research_questions: How often a manager changes the quantity after she has written the purchase order.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One purchase: she still reads what is short, still decides the quantities, still writes the order, and still sends order v1, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Across the week she still instructs the client, still supervises the student, still sends every purchase order, and still submits insurance. A configured copy only fills bookkeeping lines from sale date, amount, and item type she can already see.
reach: She still posts book v1 and still sends claim v1 herself.
Instructing a client and supervising a student stay spoken work.
The supplier receives a purchase order only after she sends order v1.
skills_to_grow: Count frames and lenses on the shelf before trusting the stock figure.
Correct a client's hold of the eyeglasses in the room.
Tell a student optician what to change during the fitting.
Match a bookkeeping line to the sale before posting book v1.
role.ambitious_version: The same optician still instructs the client, still supervises the student, still sends every purchase order, and still submits insurance. A configured copy only fills bookkeeping lines from sale date, amount, and item type she can already see.
